title: tephrosia littoralis
intro: Tephrosia littoralis, commonly known as Beachbean or Seaside Horsebean, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of various respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia littoralis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe skin irritations, alleviate coughs, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments.
